avgConfidence.description: Average confidence score across all events, expressed to 3 decimal places

confidenceBuckets.description: Distribution of events across confidence ranges. Used for histogram on dashboard.

_id.description: Lower bound of the confidence bucket. Ranges: [0–0.5), [0.5–0.7), [0.7–0.85), [0.85–1.0]

count.description: Number of events whose confidence_score falls in this bucket

qualityCategories.description: Events split into 4 quality quadrants based on confidence and success. Used for donut chart.

great.description: confidence >= 0.85 AND success = true. Robot understood well and acted correctly.

lucky.description: confidence < 0.75 AND success = true. Robot succeeded despite low confidence.

broken.description: confidence >= 0.85 AND success = false. Robot understood but failed to act.

bad.description: confidence < 0.75 AND success = false. Robot neither understood nor acted correctly.

confidenceByType.description: Per event_type breakdown of confidence, latency and success rate. Used for grouped bar chart.

avg_confidence.description: Average confidence score for this event type

avg_latency.description: Average processing latency in ms for this event type

success_rate.description: Percentage of successful events for this type

lowQualityEvents.description: Last 10 events with confidence_score < 0.6. Used for alert feed on dashboard.

qualityOverTime.description: Avg confidence and success rate per minute for the last 60 minutes. Used for dual-line chart.

avg_confidence.description: Average confidence score in this minute bucket

total.description: Number of events in this minute bucket

success_rate.description: Percentage of successful events in this minute bucket

sessionQuality.description: Quality summary per session, sorted by avg_confidence descending. Used for session leaderboard table.

avg_confidence.description: Average confidence score across all events in this session

avg_latency.description: Average processing latency in ms across all events in this session

total_events.description: Total number of events in this session

success_rate.description: Percentage of successful events in this session
